messages:
Alice Chen: Quick heads-up — from the INC-9012 postmortem we have 4 cross-team follow-ups. Doing a sweep to lock owners + escalation paths. Reply with 'I own' + due date for the item you take. Items: 1) Fix query cache TTL causing stale responses (/service/cache) 2) Canary rollback automation gap 3) Dedicated capacity config validation for Redwood Dedicated 4) Add audit logs for Private deployments. Ping deps if blocked.

Ben Lopez: I own 1 — I'll implement the TTL fix and add unit + integration tests. ETA: EOD Thu 11/9. @Carmen I can tag you in the PR for a quick smoke.

Carmen Patel: Ack. I can do the smoke test for #1 after Ben's PR lands. ETA: EOD Fri 11/10. Blocker: need a QA test env with the newer cache image. @Dinesh can you help with the image redeploy?

Dinesh Rao: I can coordinate the image redeploy — scheduling a small window Thu morning. Assigning to eng-infra. Tentative ETA: Thu 11/9 morning. Also need security approval for the image tag (CIS scan running).

Irina Volkova: I'll take 4 (audit logs). I have a draft schema and will open a PR tomorrow. ETA: Wed 11/15. Not blocked from my side.

Ben Lopez: For item 2 (canary rollback automation) I can own the rollback script itself, but need SRE help for the runbook and escalation hops. @Dinesh or @Carmen can one of you pair on runbook?

Dinesh Rao: I can own the runbook write-up and coordinate with SRE on routing + escalation. ETA: Mon 11/13. Note: runbook depends on #1 being fixed to avoid noise during rollbacks.

inc-bot: Added actions to tracker INC-9012: INC-9012-1(Ben Lopez), INC-9012-2(Ben Lopez / Dinesh Rao), INC-9012-3(unassigned), INC-9012-4(Irina Volkova).

Alice Chen: Great — please add due dates in the tracker and mark any blockers there. If anyone needs to swap ownership, say now. I'll schedule a 15m async sync Fri 09:30 PT to confirm progress. :calendar: 

Carmen Patel: If the infra redeploy slips, can we temporarily set cache TTL to 30s to reduce user impact? Ben — can you validate that toggle during your testing?

Ben Lopez: Yep, I'll include a TTL=30s fallback toggle in the PR and test it in QA.

Dinesh Rao: Noted. I'll update the tracker with the deploy window and CIS scan status once I have them.

Alice Chen: :thumbsup: Thanks all — leaving this async unless something blocks.
